entry_thesis: OXY broke out of a multi-month base on explosive volume following the US/Israel air strikes on Iran (Feb 28), with oil approaching $120/bbl and Strait of Hormuz closure risk adding supply-shock premium. As a pure-play upstream operator, OXY has 3-4x more oil-price beta than integrated majors like XOM, and just posted a massive Q4 earnings beat ($0.31 vs $0.17 consensus). RSI is elevated but not overbought as the breakout is confirmed by fundamental catalyst — the Iran war is a regime-change event for energy prices, not a one-day spike.
risk: If ceasefire/de-escalation materializes rapidly, oil retraces and OXY could pull back 10-15%; stop-loss at $49.00 (pre-war Feb 27 closing price area).
target_return: 18-22% in 15 days based on technical measured move from breakout base and continued oil price strength above $100/bbl
catalyst: Iran war escalation / Strait of Hormuz closure choking 20% of global oil supply; OXY has highest upstream leverage in energy sector; Q4 EPS beat of 82% confirmed operational momentum
